scope: 15 remaining 2007 research groups; not15 independent unknown sensors. Sources through v1.3; original capture dates withheld.

groups.evidence: Later continuous captures rechecked: first 4735 frames has one F3->F4 transition; second 7378 frames remains F4 while OBD MAP, RPM, coolant and trims vary widely.
groups.limits: Not a direct LTFT copy, MAP, ECT, fuel level, or monotonic fuel counter. BARO interpretation not supported.
groups.next_reference: Retain raw. Seek a genuinely independent Honda-specific diagnostic reference, not another unlabeled drive.
groups.prior_observations: F3 (243), F4 (244), F5 (245); low frequency +/-1 changes, F6 appears only in old 2003 studies

groups.evidence: Set during four fresh-RPM-zero intervals: drive-b 7.271s, standing 19.721s,14.202s,13.942s. Does not imply compressor rotation or present mechanical load. Electrical command/permission remains possible.
groups.limits: Not proven compressor clutch engaged. A/C switch tests did not uniquely toggle this bit. Could include electrical/fan/load control influences.
groups.next_reference: Keep a neutral label. A synchronized clutch/request diagnostic or safe physical reference is the remaining discriminator.
groups.prior_observations: Binary 0/1. Strong candidate accessory/compressor permission or cyclical load state.

groups.status: sender-related pair; B3 output updates on a 5 Hz grid; volume uncalibrated
groups.evidence: B3 changes align to 200ms multiples in 4917 examined sub-5s inter-change intervals across drive-a/drive-b/Body. B4 can change at 10ms cadence. Prior low-fuel affine fit yields body RMSE1.360 and positive mean residual1.307 raw.
groups.limits: No confirmed absolute tank volume, gallons, true %, volts or ohms. The regression is approximate and does not replace a multi-point fuel-level curve.
groups.next_reference: Keep both observed channels; use stable refueling anchors to build a volume curve. Do not convert B3 directly into tank %.
groups.prior_observations: drive-a median B3=32/B4=157 (ranges B3 5–51, B4 128–199); drive-b 28/163; body parked B3=97/B4=58 (ranges 90–103,49–69).

groups.evidence: Rechecked 25236 raw /12618 normalized increments in drive-a+drive-b. All raw values even. Retain0.105585mL/raw count or0.21117mL/normalized count as a configurable transfer from2003.
groups.limits: This volume scale is transferred from 2003, not independently metered on 2007. Do not treat resets after ignition as rollover.
groups.next_reference: One ordinary fully recorded full-to-full interval can validate volume scale. Use the correct counter modulus and reject gaps/resets.
groups.prior_observations: 16-bit BE raw counter always even in checked recordings; normalized counter is raw>>1, modulo32768; original raw modulo65536.

groups.status: upstream request-like raw channel; pedal identity unproven
groups.evidence: No change to B3 feedback calibration. B2=208 occurs both KOEO and under load. Existing shift-intervention evidence remains valid.
groups.limits: No independent pedal PID (49,4A,4B unsupported); B2 cannot be claimed final PCM actuator command or % pedal.
groups.next_reference: Expose request only as a raw/inferred quantity; no physical-pedal percentage.
groups.prior_observations: Raw 4..208 in drive-a; responds during KOEO pedal steps. During three high-load upshifts remains 208 as feedback B3 drops to 68–71 and recovers.

groups.status: state-dependent demand-related channel; not a fixed B2-only transform
groups.evidence: At B2=208, B4=199 in430 standing frames; B4 spans188..196 in2437 drive-a frames and189..195 in353 drive-b frames.
groups.limits: Not independently proven accelerator-pedal measurement, position percentage or final drive-by-wire actuator command.
groups.next_reference: Preserve B4 separately. A fixed subtraction from B2 would erase observed state-dependent information. Physical pedal identity remains unproven.
groups.prior_observations: Mostly B2−8,−9,or−10; during KOEO pedal-released B4=0; high-load B4 188..192 when B2=208.

groups.status: scaled speed representations; lower A favored for odometer-relative speed
groups.evidence: drive-a-trained B=1.020582138*A-0.069633682 predicts44994 moving drive-b samples with RMSE0.442 raw and maxabs1.332. A integration differs from fine-counter distance by-0.180% drive-a/-0.083% drive-b; higher B differs+1.873%/+1.972%.
groups.limits: No GPS verified physical speed, wheel circumference or definitive explanation for 2.06% difference. Do not use higher-speed channel automatically as odometer-ground speed.
groups.next_reference: Prefer nominal A/100 km/h for the odometer-consistent readout; retain B diagnostically. Keep confirmed1.61 and164 distance constants; physical speed still lacks GPS validation.
groups.prior_observations: Lower A and higher B nominal speed channels. B/A ≈1.0206 moving; A around 0.97984 B. Original 2003 had no occupied B0:B1.

groups.status: smoothed speed alias; exact consumer/purpose unknown
groups.evidence: drive-a-trained first-order time constant0.281s gives drive-b common-sample RMSE4.323 raw versus18.301 for a drive-a-trained pure-delay model. Both use45029 common moving samples.
groups.limits: Not independent wheel speed, not proven odometer source, fitted offset poor near standstill.
groups.next_reference: Retain as a filtered-speed diagnostic. Do not claim independent wheel speed or an exact firmware algorithm.
groups.prior_observations: BE16 raw approximately tracks high speed channel 0C8 B4:B5 with 0.27s lag and ~−52 raw count offset over moving range.

groups.status: strongly inferred night-dimming cancel / full-brightness override
groups.evidence: Body capture changes B1=80 to228 (0xE4) at255.138398s. 0xE4=0x80|100. Honda owner manual describes the full-right click as cancelling reduced night brightness.
groups.limits: Meaning of bit7 (override vs detent vs flag) unproven; B1 not a calibrated photometric 0–255 brightness percentage.
groups.next_reference: Decode lower7 bits separately from flag; use as observed override behavior with inference label. Do not treat228/255 as brightness.
groups.prior_observations: B1 states include lights-off 100/0x64, lights-on 77/0x4D, minimum24/0x18, middle48/0x30, maximum228/0xE4 (=0x80|0x64).

groups.status: initialization sentinel with a longer-inactivity association; source unknown
groups.evidence: Standing: FF absent after1.937636s/1.327294s 2E4 gaps; five FF frames after28.058187s. Two other FF startups have unknown pre-recording history.
groups.limits: Not eight independent flags, cannot prove cold boot, module/source origin, or identify device restart.
groups.next_reference: Keep a startup diagnostic, not a universal ignition flag or proven cold-boot indicator.
groups.prior_observations: B0=FF for exactly 5 packets then 00 on some startup sequences (~0.493–0.497s); other bytes remain zero except protocol.

groups.status: ON-associated bit usable only with freshness; whole-bus traffic insufficient
groups.evidence: During27.690228s without0D4, 1382 packets of20C continue with B0=0; other nine IDs have no frames inside that interval.
groups.limits: Cannot distinguish ACC vs OFF using this bit; no long-term network sleep interval measured.
groups.next_reference: Distinguish fresh bit-set/fresh bit-clear/stale-unknown. ACC versus OFF and long-term network sleep remain unresolved.
groups.prior_observations: 2 with ignition ON, 0 during ACC/OFF in labeled standing sequence; 20C messages can continue while fast engine IDs stop.

groups.location: B6 bit3 cruise engaged + 0D4 B0 buttons

groups.evidence: No independently observed cruise target speed was added by this pass.
groups.limits: No separately decoded numerical target set speed; nominal observed speed is not exact cruise command.

groups.status: gear and reported shifts known; converter lockup/temperature absent

groups.limits: Not torque converter clutch lockup CAN bit, measured clutch transfer duration, transmission fluid temperature or input/turbine RPM.
groups.next_reference: Keep coupling/shift inferences explicit; source missing quantities through independently supported diagnostics.
